It calculates the manual “adjustment dose” required to bring your Ca (and all other elements) from their “Current” level to the “Desired” level. It assumes all elements are already in balance.

It calculates the actual Ca uptake of your aquarium and recommends the optimal “daily dose” for your system. This is based on the volume of Part#1 dosed by the ReefDose between the times of the selected “Current” and “Previous” Ca tests.

Measure your salinity and test the Ca level using an accurate test kit and enter in the “Ca test log” with the time that the sample was taken from the aquarium. The calculator normalizes all Ca readings to the “desired” salinity you have set. If you do not know the salinity, the calculator will assume that it is at the desired level. The default “Current” test is the newest in the log, and the default “Previous” is the one before that. You can select different test results from the log. Click here for the manual
Select test results for dosing calculator. \"Previous\" and \"Current\" are used for the daily dose calculation. Desired level and \"Current\" are used for the adjustment dose calculation.
The Calculator simplifies maintaining the correct water parameters when using the 4-Part ReefCare program with the ReefDose.
